Definition
[Locally curvature essential sequences] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0251 1. Definition 8.11\group dilations-of-singularities

A sequence $(x_i,t_i)$ is locally curvature essential if $t_i\nearrow T\le \infty $ and there exist $C<\infty $ and radii $r_i\in (0,\sqrt{t_i})$ such that \[ \sup \Bigl\{ |\Rm (x,t)| : x\in \overline B_{g(t)}(x_i,r_i),\ t\in [t_i-r_i^2,t_i]\Bigr\} \le C r_i^{-2} \] for all $i$.
